x-q4t.query_parameters: route-specific closed fields; unlisted fields return400

native_ingress.backend_identity: native ingress authenticates and replaces internal identity headers

gateway_client_policy.transport: loopback text or explicit media profile
gateway_client_policy.identity: gateway overwrites internal headers; runner validates configured client and independent shared credential before body admission
limits: optional v2 fixed-window requests/tokens per minute

governance.enabled_by: explicit v2 policy fields; zero disables rates
governance.reservation: full prompt plus available output, retained across windows
governance.settlement: slot-admitted full prompt plus logical output, including failure/cancellation
governance.fair_queue: prepared-slot client round robin, per-client bounded queue share

gateway_client_policy.defaults: omitted/null output budget is min(server default, client output limit)
gateway_client_policy.local_admin: exact GET health/liveness/readiness/config/metrics remain trusted same-host routes; gateway denies them

x-q4t.deployment: controlled local/internal service; public deployment not accepted
x-q4t.streaming_response_schema_scope: envelopes; sequencing and tool semantics require client validation
